findings.body: The previous metadata gap remains open. Admission snapshots `chosen`, but Autoreview selection and fallback update only `selected` and activity records at review.py:603–611. Worker fallback replaces `chosen` at worker.py:165 without updating the lane entry. Both reader paths join using repo.models at story.py:222 and :230; repo.py:411–419 can return an empty selection, while subsequent selection events at repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386 update only activity records. Consequently, board lane entries can show null or obsolete model/effort values during actual runs. Refresh the shared entry across these selection paths.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

findings.body: The previously deferred integration remains outstanding. fasttest.py:271 launches tests directly, and review.py:279–288 uses the separate ticket queue. Neither registers shared test entries, so the machine view cannot expose their output/progress and `forge stop` cannot cancel tests or stop an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level proofs to TESTS; this remains advice for that task rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
